definitions: Find a solution to (a problem, dispute, or difficult situation).
Decide firmly on a course of action.
Separate or break into constituent parts.
Reduce (a substance) by a chemical or physical process.
Of a musical chord or dissonance) move to a consonance.
Of a person) make a firm decision to do something.
examples: The committee resolves the issue quickly.
She resolves to finish the project by Friday.
The image resolves into individual pixels.
The dominant seventh resolves to the tonic.
He resolves to improve his grades.
